ax_inv.set_facecolor('none')

# ── Colors ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

C_INDUSTRY  = '#81C784'   # green
C_REGUL     = '#FFB74D'   # amber
C_CHATGPT   = '#FF6B6B'   # red accent
C_INV       = '#CE93D8'   # lavender
C_AXIS      = '#8B949E'
C_BG_SHADE  = '#161b22'
C_LABEL     = '#E6EDF3'

# Track y-positions
Y_RES  = 3.0
Y_IND  = 2.0
Y_REG  = 1.0

ax.set_ylim(0.2, 4.1)
ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xticks(range(2010, 2025))
ax.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in range(2010, 2025)],
                   fontsize=9, color=C_AXIS, fontfamily='monospace')
ax.tick_params(axis='x', length=6, color=C_AXIS, pad=4)
for spine in ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)
ax.axhline(y=0.2, color=C_AXIS, lw=0.5, alpha=0.4)

# ── Pre/post ChatGPT background shading ───────────────────────────────────────
CHATGPT_X = 2022.92
ax.axvspan(XMIN, CHATGPT_X, alpha=0.04, color='white', zorder=0)
ax.axvspan(CHATGPT_X, XMAX, alpha=0.10, color='#FF6B6B', zorder=0)

# ChatGPT anchor line
ax.axvline(x=CHATGPT_X, color=C_CHATGPT, lw=2.0, alpha=0.9, linestyle='--', zorder=5)
ax.text(CHATGPT_X + 0.04, 3.78, "ChatGPT\nNov 2022", color=C_CHATGPT,
        fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', va='top', ha='left',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='#1a0a0a', edgecolor=C_CHATGPT, alpha=0.85))

# ── Track baselines ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for y, color in [(Y_RES, C_RESEARCH), (Y_IND, C_INDUSTRY), (Y_REG, C_REGUL)]:
    ax.axhline(y=y, color=color, lw=1.2, alpha=0.3, zorder=1, xmin=0, xmax=1)

for y, label, color in [
    (Y_RES, "RESEARCH", C_RESEARCH),
    (Y_IND, "INDUSTRY", C_INDUSTRY),
    (Y_REG, "REGULATORY", C_REGUL),
]:

def jitter_label(i, total, base_y, direction=1):
    offsets = [0.28, 0.52, 0.72, 0.44, 0.60, 0.36, 0.56, 0.48, 0.68]
    return base_y + direction * offsets[i % len(offsets)]

    times = [m[0] for m in milestones]
    # cluster detection — track x-positions used
    label_y_used = {}
    for idx, (t, label) in enumerate(milestones):
        is_post = t >= CHATGPT_X
        alpha_m = 1.0 if is_post else 0.75
        size_m  = 7 if is_post else 5
        ax.plot(t, y_base, marker=marker, color=color, ms=size_m,
                alpha=alpha_m, zorder=6, markeredgecolor='#0d1117', markeredgewidth=0.6)
        # vertical tick
        ly = y_base + direction * 0.06
        ax.plot([t, t], [y_base, ly], color=color, lw=0.8, alpha=0.5, zorder=4)

def plot_labels(milestones, y_base, color, direction=1):
    # Build label positions avoiding overlap
    sorted_m = sorted(milestones, key=lambda x: x[0])
    positions = []  # (x, y_label)
    # Stagger y with spacing
    y_levels = np.linspace(0.12, 0.70, 7)
    prev_x = -999
    level_idx = 0
    for t, label in sorted_m:
        is_post = t >= CHATGPT_X
        fs = 6.0 if is_post else 5.5
        fc = color if is_post else '#6a7580'
        if t - prev_x < 0.5:
            level_idx = (level_idx + 1) % len(y_levels)
        else:
            level_idx = 0
        prev_x = t
        y_lbl = y_base + direction * (0.08 + y_levels[level_idx])
        ax.annotate(
            label, xy=(t, y_base), xytext=(t, y_lbl),
            textcoords='data',
            fontsize=fs, color=fc, ha='center', va='bottom' if direction > 0 else 'top',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=color, alpha=0.25, lw=0.6),
            zorder=7,
        )

plot_milestones(regulatory, Y_REG, C_REGUL,    direction=-1)
plot_labels(research,   Y_RES, C_RESEARCH, direction=1)
plot_labels(industry,   Y_IND, C_INDUSTRY, direction=-1)
plot_labels(regulatory, Y_REG, C_REGUL,    direction=-1)

ax_inv.set_xlim(XMIN, XMAX)
ax_inv.set_ylim(0, 160)
ax_inv.set_yticks([])
ax_inv.set_xticks([])

ax_inv2.tick_params(colors=C_INV, length=3)

ax_inv.text(2019.2, 33.6*0.25 + 0.3, "$34B", color=C_INV, fontsize=6.5, va='bottom')

                     "Purple area = annual global AI private investment (right axis).",
         ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8.5, color=C_AXIS, style='italic')

# ── Legend ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend_elements = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='none', markerfacecolor=C_RESEARCH, ms=8,
           label='Research Breakthrough'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='none', markerfacecolor=C_INDUSTRY, ms=8,
           label='Industry Adoption'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='none', markerfacecolor=C_REGUL, ms=8,
           label='Regulatory Action'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=C_INV, alpha=0.5, label='Global AI Investment (bn USD)'),
    Line2D([0], [0], color=C_CHATGPT, lw=2, linestyle='--', label='ChatGPT Launch (Nov 2022)'),
]
leg = ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left', framealpha=0.2,
                facecolor='#1c2128', edgecolor='#30363d', fontsize=8,
                labelcolor=C_LABEL, ncol=5, bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, 1.01))

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=fig.get_facecolor())
print("Saved /app/output/result.png")
